items.title: Learn T-SQL With Erik: Aligning Queries and Indexes Part 6
items.author: Erik Darling (Erik Darling Data)
items.summary:
In this video, I dive into the fascinating world of missing index requests in SQL Server query plans. Erik Darling from Darling Data shares his experience and a humorous anecdote about developers relying solely on these requests without understanding their limitations. We explore how missing index requests can be misleading and often don't reflect real-world performance improvements effectively. By analyzing execution plans and understanding the nuances of key columns, equality and inequality predicates, I show you how to make more informed decisions when considering indexing strategies. Join me as we debunk some common myths about these requests and learn valuable insights for optimizing your queries and indexes.

CHAPTERS

00:00:00 - Introduction
00:00:22 - Funny Story
00:01:11 - Missing Index Requests
00:03:13 - Query Plan Overview
00:04:02 - Impact Number Explanation
00:05:20 - Getting an Execution Plan
00:06:20 - Understanding Selectivity
00:07:37 - Ordinal Position Importance
00:08:14 - Example Query Analysis
00:11:00 - Execution Plan Scans
00:12:01 - Reversing Indexes
00:13:01 - Taking Missing Index Requests
00:13:57 - Conclusion
